author: thegreatrevealo
quote:
A GTA game that punishes your play style, locking you out of the best endings. You have much more restriction in this game than any previous title. 
There is little to no satire that the franchise is known for. They had lost Dan Houser and Leslie Benzies at Rockstar and you can feel the effect. The character traits of our protagonists are shallow and lacking. There is a definite favorite amongst the devs/creators/writers at Rockstar, Lucia is propped up to be the ultimate protagonist in this game, while Jason does all he can to hide behind her. 
The UI menus are also soulless and do not ooze with GTA sauce. You could call this game something else, and I would believe it. It does not feel recognizable as a GTA title.

Very unfitting addition to the franchise.
